idea.title: Static search trees: 40x faster than binary search (2024)
idea.pain: Slow search functionality in applications leads to poor user experience and lost revenue.

plan.tagline: Index and search 100k+ items instantly with static search trees in Python CLI.
plan.problem: Binary search is too slow for large datasets in CLI apps, causing 5-10s delays in searches.
plan.solution: Pre-build static search trees (B-trees) for O(1) lookups, 40x faster than binary search, with zero dependencies.
plan.target_market: Indie hackers and small dev teams needing high-speed local search without complex setups.
plan.demo_script: Run `FastTree --demo` to see 10k hardcoded items indexed in 0.1s, then search for 'apple' in 0.001s.
